---
title: "CanProTarget Report"
output:
  html_document:
    css: report_style.css
    self_contained: true
    toc: false
    theme: null
    highlight: null
    mathjax: null
params:
  gene: "KRAS"
  subtype: "Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma"
  dataset: "CRISPR"
  data_dir: "data"
  project_root: "."
---

```{r hide-title, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat('<style>.title { display: none; }</style>')
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5, dpi = 200,
                      fig.align = "center", out.width = "100%")
knitr::opts_knit$set(unnamed.chunk.label = "cpt-chunk")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
})

source(file.path(params$project_root, "R", "app_helpers.R"))
source(file.path(params$project_root, "R", "api_functions.R"))
source(file.path(params$project_root, "R", "canprotarget_score.R"))
source(file.path(params$project_root, "R", "pancancer_profile.R"))
source(file.path(params$project_root, "R", "theme_canprotarget.R"))

cpt_theme <- function() theme_canprotarget(base_size = 12)

# Build data environment
data_dir <- file.path(params$project_root, params$data_dir)
data_env <- list(data_dir = data_dir)

crispr_path <- file.path(data_dir, "CRISPRGeneEffect_23Q4_clean.rds")
if (file.exists(crispr_path)) data_env$crispr_matrix <- readRDS(crispr_path)

rnai_path <- file.path(data_dir, "d2_gene_effect_headers_refined.rds")
if (file.exists(rnai_path)) data_env$rnai_matrix <- readRDS(rnai_path)

meta_path <- file.path(data_dir, "cancer_model_data.rds")
if (file.exists(meta_path)) data_env$cancer_model_data <- readRDS(meta_path)

cys_path <- file.path(data_dir, "cys_editing_atlas.rds")
if (file.exists(cys_path)) data_env$cys_atlas <- readRDS(cys_path)

# Data provenance
data_versions <- read_data_versions(data_dir)
provenance <- data_provenance_string(data_versions)

# Logo lives in www/ at runtime (shinyapps); graphics/ is the repo copy.
logo_candidates <- c(
  file.path(params$project_root, "www", "cpt_logo.png"),
  file.path(params$project_root, "graphics", "cpt_logo.png")
)
logo_path <- logo_candidates[file.exists(logo_candidates)][1]
logo_b64 <- if (!is.na(logo_path) && nzchar(logo_path)) {
  paste0("data:image/png;base64,", base64enc::base64encode(logo_path))
} else {
  ""
}
```

```{r compute, include=FALSE}
dep_result <- tryCatch(
  api_query_dependency(params$gene, params$subtype, params$dataset, data_env),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

score_result <- tryCatch(
  api_canprotarget_score(params$gene, params$subtype, params$dataset, data_env),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

pancancer_result <- tryCatch(
  api_pancancer_profile(params$gene, params$dataset, data_env, top_n = 30L),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

cys_result <- tryCatch(
  api_gene_cysteines(params$gene, data_env),
  error = function(e) NULL
)
```

```{r header, results='asis'}
# Empty src="" makes pandoc --self-contained fail with error 99
# ("File  not found in resource path").
logo_cell <- if (nzchar(logo_b64)) {
  sprintf('<td><img src="%s" alt="CanProTarget" style="width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:8px;"></td>', logo_b64)
} else {
  "<td></td>"
}
cat(sprintf('<div class="cpt-report-header"><table><tr>%s<td><h1>CanProTarget</h1><p class="cpt-report-type">Gene Dependency Report: %s in %s</p><p class="cpt-report-meta">Generated %s &middot; %s dataset &middot; %s</p></td></tr></table></div>',
  logo_cell, params$gene, params$subtype,
  format(Sys.time(), "%B %d, %Y"), params$dataset, provenance))
```

```{r summary, results='asis'}
cat('<div class="cpt-summary-card">\n')

# Interpretation line
if (!is.null(dep_result)) {
  cat(sprintf("<p><strong>%s</strong></p>\n", dep_result$interpretation))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("<p>Dependency data not available for %s in %s.</p>\n", params$gene, params$subtype))
}

# CPT Score circle
has_score <- !is.null(score_result) &&
  !is.null(score_result$cpt_score) &&
  length(score_result$cpt_score) == 1 &&
  !is.na(score_result$cpt_score)
if (has_score) {
  # Prefer guarded priority from cpt_score_single (never high for non-deps)
  priority <- if (exists("cpt_priority_display", mode = "function")) {
    cpt_priority_display(score_result)
  } else if (!is.null(score_result$priority) && nzchar(as.character(score_result$priority)[1])) {
    p0 <- as.character(score_result$priority)[1]
    switch(p0,
      high = "High priority",
      moderate = "Moderate priority",
      low = "Low priority",
      paste0(p0, " priority")
    )
  } else if (score_result$cpt_score >= 70) {
    "High priority"
  } else if (score_result$cpt_score >= 40) {
    "Moderate priority"
  } else {
    "Low priority"
  }
  # Visual class follows guarded priority, not raw score alone
  score_class <- if (grepl("^High", priority, ignore.case = TRUE)) "cpt-score-high"
    else if (grepl("^Moderate", priority, ignore.case = TRUE)) "cpt-score-moderate"
    else "cpt-score-low"

  cat(sprintf('<div class="cpt-score-container"><div class="cpt-score-circle %s">%s</div><div class="cpt-score-label"><strong>CPT Score: %s / 100</strong><br>%s target (%d of 6 evidence dimensions available)</div></div>',
    score_class, round(score_result$cpt_score), round(score_result$cpt_score, 1),
    priority, score_result$n_dimensions_used))
}
cat('</div>\n')
```

## Dependency Statistics

```{r stats_table, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(dep_result)) {
  stats_df <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "Mean gene effect (subtype)",
      "Mean gene effect (other cancers)",
      "Effect size (selectivity)",
      "p-value (one-sided t-test)",
      "Cell lines in subtype",
      "Cell lines (other)",
      "Is dependency (mean < -0.5)",
      "Is selective (p < 0.05, ES < -0.1)"
    ),
    Value = c(
      sprintf("%.4f", dep_result$cancer_mean_effect),
      sprintf("%.4f", dep_result$other_mean_effect),
      sprintf("%.4f", dep_result$effect_size),
      format(dep_result$p_value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 3),
      as.character(dep_result$n_cell_lines_in_subtype),
      as.character(dep_result$n_cell_lines_other),
      ifelse(dep_result$is_dependency, "Yes", "No"),
      ifelse(dep_result$is_selective_dependency, "Yes", "No")
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  knitr::kable(stats_df, format = "html", escape = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## CPT Score Breakdown

```{r score_bars, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(score_result) && !is.null(score_result$dimensions)) {
  dims <- score_result$dimensions
  dim_info <- list(
    list(name = "Dependency Strength", key = "dependency_strength"),
    list(name = "Cancer Selectivity", key = "cancer_selectivity"),
    list(name = "Cysteine Ligandability", key = "cysteine_ligandability"),
    list(name = "Conservation", key = "conservation"),
    list(name = "Clinical Evidence", key = "clinical_evidence"),
    list(name = "ADME / Drug-likeness", key = "adme_druggability")
  )

  for (d in dim_info) {
    val <- dims[[d$key]]$score
    if (is.null(val) || is.na(val)) {
      cat(sprintf(
        '<div class="cpt-dim-bar"><span class="label">%s</span><span class="bar-bg"><span class="bar-fill" style="width:0%%;background:#ccc;"></span></span><span class="value">N/A</span></div>\n',
        d$name))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf(
        '<div class="cpt-dim-bar"><span class="label">%s</span><span class="bar-bg"><span class="bar-fill" style="width:%.0f%%"></span></span><span class="value">%.0f</span></div>\n',
        d$name, val, val))
    }
  }

  # Description table
  cat("\n\n")
  desc_df <- data.frame(
    Dimension = sapply(dim_info, function(d) d$name),
    Score = sapply(dim_info, function(d) {
      v <- dims[[d$key]]$score
      if (is.null(v) || is.na(v)) "Not available" else sprintf("%.1f / 100", v)
    }),
    Description = sapply(dim_info, function(d) dims[[d$key]]$description),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  knitr::kable(desc_df, format = "html", escape = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Pan-Cancer Dependency Profile

```{r pancancer_plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
if (!is.null(pancancer_result) && length(pancancer_result$subtypes) > 0) {
  pc_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(pancancer_result$subtypes, function(s) {
    data.frame(
      subtype = s$subtype,
      mean_effect = s$mean_effect,
      n_cell_lines = s$n_cell_lines,
      is_dependency = s$is_dependency,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))

  pc_df$is_target <- pc_df$subtype == params$subtype
  pc_df$subtype_label <- paste0(pc_df$subtype, " (n=", pc_df$n_cell_lines, ")")
  pc_df$subtype_label <- factor(pc_df$subtype_label,
    levels = pc_df$subtype_label[order(pc_df$mean_effect, decreasing = TRUE)])

  ggplot(pc_df, aes(x = subtype_label, y = mean_effect, fill = is_target)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#999999", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = "#7bafd4", "TRUE" = "#cc3340"),
      labels = c("Other subtypes", params$subtype),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Mean gene effect score",
      title = paste0(params$gene, " dependency across cancer subtypes"),
      subtitle = paste0("Top ", nrow(pc_df), " most dependent subtypes (",
                        params$dataset, " dataset)"),
      caption = "Dashed line = dependency threshold (-0.5)"
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    cpt_theme() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.justification = "left",
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, colour = "#666666"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, colour = "#999999", hjust = 0)
    )
}
```

```{r pancancer_interp, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(pancancer_result)) {
  n_dep <- pancancer_result$n_dependency_subtypes
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p style='color:#6c757d;font-size:0.88em;text-align:center;margin-top:-8px;'>%s is a dependency (mean effect &lt; -0.5) in <strong>%d of %d</strong> cancer subtypes. %s</p>\n",
    params$gene, n_dep, pancancer_result$total_subtypes,
    if (n_dep > 10) "Broadly essential across many cancers."
    else if (n_dep >= 3) "Moderately selective."
    else "Highly selective target."
  ))
}
```

## Druggable Cysteines

```{r cysteine_section, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(cys_result) && cys_result$total_sites > 0) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>%s</strong> has <strong>%d</strong> cysteine site(s) in the functional editing atlas: %d functional, %d ligandable, %d functional+ligandable.</p>\n",
    cys_result$gene, cys_result$total_sites,
    cys_result$n_functional, cys_result$n_ligandable, cys_result$n_functional_ligandable))

  # Filter to interesting sites
  site_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cys_result$sites, function(s) {
    data.frame(
      Site = s$site_id,
      Pos = s$cysteine_position,
      Functional = ifelse(isTRUE(s$functional), "\u2713", ""),
      Ligandable = ifelse(isTRUE(s$ligandable), "\u2713", ""),
      `Priority` = ifelse(isTRUE(s$functional_ligandable), "\u2713", ""),
      Editor = ifelse(is.null(s$editor_support), "", s$editor_support),
      `Lig. Score` = ifelse(is.null(s$ligandability_score), "",
                            sprintf("%.0f", s$ligandability_score)),
      Conservation = ifelse(is.null(s$conservation_score), "",
                            sprintf("%.0f%%", s$conservation_score * 100)),
      ClinVar = ifelse(isTRUE(s$clinvar_pathogenic), "Pathogenic", ""),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  }))
  knitr::kable(site_df, format = "html", escape = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  cat(sprintf("<p>No cysteine data available for %s in the functional editing atlas.</p>\n", params$gene))
}
```

## External Resources

```{r links, results='asis'}
# Get UniProt accession: try cysteine result first, then do direct lookup
uniprot_id <- NULL
if (!is.null(cys_result) && !is.null(cys_result$uniprot_accession)) {
  uniprot_id <- cys_result$uniprot_accession
}
# Fallback: direct atlas lookup for UniProt even if gene_cysteines failed
if ((is.null(uniprot_id) || is.na(uniprot_id) || !nzchar(uniprot_id)) && !is.null(data_env$cys_atlas)) {
  atlas_hit <- data_env$cys_atlas[toupper(data_env$cys_atlas$gene_symbol) == toupper(params$gene), ]
  if (nrow(atlas_hit) > 0) {
    uniprot_id <- atlas_hit$uniprot_accession[1]
  }
}

cat('<div class="cpt-links">\n')
cat('<table style="border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;"><tr>\n')

# Structure links column
cat('<td style="vertical-align:top;padding:8px;width:50%;">\n')
cat('<p style="margin:0 0 6px 0;"><strong>Structure &amp; Protein</strong></p><ul style="margin:0;padding-left:18px;">\n')
if (!is.null(uniprot_id) && !is.na(uniprot_id) && nzchar(uniprot_id)) {
  cat(sprintf('<li><a href="https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/entry/%s" target="_blank">AlphaFold Structure (%s)</a></li>\n', uniprot_id, uniprot_id))
  cat(sprintf('<li><a href="https://www.uniprot.org/uniprot/%s" target="_blank">UniProt Entry (%s)</a></li>\n', uniprot_id, uniprot_id))
} else {
  cat(sprintf('<li><a href="https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb?query=%s" target="_blank">UniProt Search (%s)</a></li>\n', params$gene, params$gene))
}
cat(sprintf('<li><a href="https://www.rcsb.org/search?q=%s" target="_blank">PDB Search (%s)</a></li>\n', params$gene, params$gene))
cat('</ul></td>\n')

# Data portal links column
cat('<td style="vertical-align:top;padding:8px;width:50%;">\n')
cat('<p style="margin:0 0 6px 0;"><strong>Data Portals</strong></p><ul style="margin:0;padding-left:18px;">\n')
cat(sprintf('<li><a href="https://depmap.org/portal/gene/%s?tab=overview" target="_blank">DepMap Portal (%s)</a></li>\n', params$gene, params$gene))
cat(sprintf('<li><a href="https://www.genecards.org/cgi-bin/carddisp.pl?gene=%s" target="_blank">GeneCards (%s)</a></li>\n', params$gene, params$gene))
cat(sprintf('<li><a href="https://www.oncokb.org/gene/%s" target="_blank">OncoKB (%s)</a></li>\n', params$gene, params$gene))
cat('</ul></td>\n')

cat('</tr></table></div>\n')
```
